ety.text: From Old English āne (“(for) a”) hwīle (“while”).

senses.d: For some time; for a short time.
ex: Take two cupfuls of rolled oats, put in bread pan, turn on four cupfuls of boiling water, stir for awhile.

senses.d: In the meantime; during an implicit ongoing process.
ex: Can I get you a drink awhile?

grp.label: For some time; for a short time

ety.text: Compare Italian un po', Portuguese um pouco and Spanish un poco.
